title: Corporate Communications
overview: In the contemporary business landscape, high-profile corporate scandals have created a challenging atmosphere for organizations, impacting their ability to conduct business, maintain effective communication, and safeguard a positive image and reputation. Recognizing the critical role of sustainable communication in organizational health, this course delves into the theories, tools, and perspectives of corporate and organizational communication. It aims to foster the development of participants as communication professionals, providing practical insights to navigate complex communication challenges both within a company and externally.
audience: Individuals seeking a comprehensive understanding of corporate communication, along with managers, supervisors, and officers with experience in public relations, will benefit from this course. It is also relevant for key personnel whose roles involve interactions within the organization or in the external public sphere
methodology: This course utilizes individual and group exercises to facilitate participants' comprehension of key characteristics in corporate communication. It incorporates case studies and encourages participant presentations, fostering discussions for a comprehensive learning experience
competencies: Strategic planning, organizational skills, and leadership
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Utilize diverse techniques and tools for implementing successful corporate communication initiatives
Plan and execute corporate communication programs both internally and externally
Recognize and leverage specialized areas within corporate communication
Apply corporate communication in the context of new organizational developments
Adapt to various communication channels within the organization

items.text: Explore and define the concept and history of corporate communication
Distinguish between vision, mission, and objectives
Corporate communication in a dynamic environment
The evolving media landscape: challenges and opportunities
Significance of corporate identity and reputation
Corporate communication strategy and strategic planning
Planning and executing communication programs and campaigns
Theories on assessing the effects of communication
Various impacts of news coverage on corporate communication
Benefits and challenges of using social media
Corporate social responsibility (CSR) and community relations
The 8 key areas of focus for CSR
